status: PILOT, declared 2026-11-17 before any object rollout of c3 scenes. Supersedes the draft for execution; the draft is kept.

source.robot_configuration: cfg2 (Flexiv Rizon, Dahuan AG-95, wrist F/T)

not_admitted.s1,s2,s6,s7,s8: more than one grasp (c2 rule); s6-s8 also final-frame fit not evaluable
not_admitted.s10: c3: object pushed during the approach (E2/E3 disagree by 36 mm; no clear replay start)

episodes.split: B=1 has no selection and is evaluated on both admitted episodes. B=5 selection uses both admitted episodes, so no held-out episode remains: the held-out matrix is NOT RUN (protocol gate '>=3 held-out successes' not met).

fixed.finger_rule: CLOSED: cmd <= width-2 mm, width stalled (<0.5 mm over 0.15 s) at >=1 mm, segment >=0.3 s; closing force fades over last 0.5 mm
fixed.replay_window: c3: from 0.3 s before the stall (earlier until pads clear) to withdrawal >=50 mm + 2 s settle
fixed.perturbation: object xy U(+-0.5 mm), yaw U(+-0.5 deg), identical arrays for all engines
fixed.seed_rule: seed0 + 1000*(episode_index+1) + cell_index; seed0=91100; episode index s5=0, s9=1

stages: acquired (reported, unscored: E3) -> carried -> placed -> retained (primary); see rp_task.evaluate
goal_predicate: touch rack (<=3 mm), pads clear, centre in rack footprint, axis within 45 deg of rails, lean <= atan(2 pitch/peg height)+10 deg (58.5), at rest over last 0.5 s (<=10 mm/s, <=0.05 rad/s)
flags: deep_penetration (pad: >0.5 wall; rack: >0.5 peg diameter; table: >0.5 bottom), penetration_assisted, ejected (>3x max TCP speed), large_slip (>10 mm or >10 deg in hand), full_closure_on_object (pads closed through or past the object during a recorded hold)

ipc (libuipc 0.0.29 ABD).others: registry a3 set (d_hat 1/0.3/0.1 mm, eps_v 1e-3, newton tol 1e-4)
ipc (libuipc 0.0.29 ABD).status: NOT RUN: ~0.3-0.6 s per step on the shared GPU (>5 h per rollout); adapter drive gate fails orientation (0.73 deg > 0.5 deg)

selection_rule: valid+correct rollouts summed over selection cells (nominal, both admitted episodes), then fewest flagged rollouts, then wall time

matrix_run.P3a: MuJoCo and SAP on all c2-admitted episodes
matrix_run.P4: nominal cell, 5 candidates per engine, 2 episodes, R=20
matrix_run.P5: NOT RUN (no held-out episode under c3)
matrix_run.c2_reference: B=1 nominal and B=5 selection on c2 scenes kept as the 'before grasp conditioning' evidence

verdict_rule.claims: README 4.3; with one episode per class, every statement is per-episode and engine-vs-engine, not 'reproducing reality'
